newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corp bonds new supply to hit peak on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corp bonds new supply to hit peak on Thursday.

text.p: U.S. corporate junk bond and investment-grade issuance should reach a climax for the week with a long line of new deals expected to hit the market on Thursday, syndicate officials said.

The swollen new issue calendar, particularly in the junk bond market, was causing little concern among Wall Street players. They expected the large supply to be easily absorbed by investment managers with large amounts of cash on hand.
So favorable are market conditions that RJR Nabisco Holdings plans to sell $350 million in debt on Thursday, despite the market volatility caused by a proposed tobacco settlement.
